shared_supplier_exercise.rule: rule 2.4 as written: a removal is per host and match pair (a comparison that shares the host's supplier leaves that host's stack only); each host keeps its remaining matches with no rematching; hosts left with fewer than five are named and kept; hosts left with none or with no weight are named as not estimable. influence.leave_out (every stack) is NOT used, since it is rule 7's deletion.

known_omissions.evidence: The table's row for Sierra Pacific Power names its supplier 'own generation (Sierra Pacific Power, fleet run jointly with Nevada Power)' for 2017 only, from NV Energy slides on the Nevada Governor's Office of Energy site: 'the generation fleet is managed as a single operation across Nevada Power Company and Sierra Pacific Power Company. Documents 2017 only. Whether that joint operation is a system agreement allocating generation costs by formula was not established; Nevada Power is not among the units in scope.' The plan names it: 'a system agreement is not detectable from the table (Sierra Pacific's fleet, run jointly with Nevada Power, may be one)'. The table has no kind for a system agreement and own generation is never a shared supplier by name, so the exact-string comparison cannot see it. 13407:NV is Nevada Power Co's EIA id and state in the quantities file.

Stage 1 and stage 2 hold the flat-history rate and the range's miss rate by process; power_simulation.json holds the flat-history rate and power for planted level effects; none holds a planted drift. inference_check.json holds 'with_a_pre_trend_of_1pct_a_year' for the bootstrap as built on an earlier design (D-49, D-53); it is not under the selected procedure or on this design and is not substituted. On file since 2026-11-20 in a record of its own, data/frozen/early_years_drift_selected_procedure.json (one authorized exercise, D-113 and D-114), which this module does not read.
step_e.g12_mean_estimate_with_nothing_planted: not in the three step E files. inference_comparison_stage1.json, by_candidate.C.by_process.G12_fuel_shocks_not_linear_in_the_share holds its rates, widths, power at a planted 5% ramp and realised_path (slope of the estimate on the realised change -0.017831, root mean square error 0.024270); no mean estimate. inference_validation_stage2.json holds rates only. On file since 2026-11-20 in a record of its own, data/frozen/g12_mean_estimate_nothing_planted.json (one authorized exercise, D-113 and D-114); the mean, the slope and the root-mean-square error are carried from that record, with their sources and units, under g12_descriptive_diagnostics beside this entry (Joe, 2026-11-20, D-115).

g12_descriptive_diagnostics.statement: The mean is zero in expectation under the construction and cannot establish adequacy of the fuel adjustment, and a mean away from zero would not necessarily identify a failure of that adjustment either. The mean, the slope and the root-mean-square error are descriptive diagnostics, not a new validation verdict or selection criterion (Joe, 2026-11-20, D-115). No threshold is set for any of them, no fuel control is changed, and no simulation was run to produce them.

units.mean_estimate_pct: the mean of the headline estimate with nothing planted, in log points, reported as percent (100 times log points)
units.slope_of_the_estimate_on_the_realised_ch: the change in the headline estimate, in log points, for one log point of realised change in the common walk between a host's reference year and its event years 2 and 3 (their mean), averaged over hosts with the design's weights (inference_comparison.realised_change); a ratio of log points to log points, so it has no unit
units.root_mean_square_error_pct: the root-mean-square error of the estimate about the true value of zero, in log points, reported as percent (100 times log points), the unit of the mean
